question.text: Which of these is part of the STATIC section (Part I) of the Disclosure Document?

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Static section includes disclaimer, definitions, description, penalties, services, risk factors, expenses, taxation, accounting policies, investor services, diversification policy. **The Trap:** Client rep, financial performance and audit obs are Dynamic (Part II). **Cross-Exam Context:** Structure from SEBI Sep 2025 circular. **Distributor's Pro-Tip:** Update the Dynamic section quarterly; keep Static changes rare and well-documented.
